description: This header declares the SleepExecutor class, which implements an ExecutorInterface for scheduling sleep-related actions based on timestamps or delays.

classes.name: SleepExecutor
classes.description: A class that provides scheduling methods for sleep execution, inheriting from ExecutorInterface.

methods.name: scheduleByTimestamp
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be invoked at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: scheduleForLater
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be invoked after a specified delay.
